info.name: Delivez — Rider App (work: attendance, deliveries, earnings)
info.description:
Everything an **approved** rider does in the **Delivez Agent** app after sign-up (sign-up itself is in *Delivez — Driver (Rider) Registration*).

1. Choose the **Production** environment, set `riderPhone` (an approved rider), run *1. Rider sign-in* (put the SMS code in `otpCode` before *Verify*).
2. *2. Attendance*: presign + upload a selfie, then **Punch in**. That also puts the rider online.
3. *3 / 4*: GPS ping → **Current offer** → **Accept**. The task id is saved.
4. *5. The delivery*: the steps in order. The shop confirms the pickup with the rider's handover code. Pick one *Delivered* request.
5. *6*: history and earnings. *7*: ops vehicles and shifts (admin login).

Money is in **paise**. Errors: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }`; show `message` to the rider as it is. Full guide: RIDER_APP_WORK_API.md.

⚠ Production: punches, deliveries and cash records are real. Use a test rider and only orders meant for testing.

item.name: 2. Attendance (punch in / breaks / punch out)
item.description:
NOT_PUNCHED_IN → punch-in → SHIFT_ACTIVE ⇄ ON_BREAK → punch-out → SHIFT_COMPLETED.

Photos: **Presign** → **Upload** (pick the file in Body → binary) → use the saved key. `capturedAt` must be within 10 minutes (`{{now}}` is set for you). GPS accuracy above 100 m is refused.

Use the *company vehicle* punch-in / punch-out when `GET /rider/vehicle` says `required: true`.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); console.log('status:', j.status, '· online:', j.online, '· company vehicle required:', j.companyVehicleRequired);

if (v) { pm.collectionVariables.set('vehicleId', v.vehicleId); pm.collectionVariables.set('vehicleCheckIds', JSON.stringify(v.checklist.checks.map((c) => c.id))); pm.collectionVariables.set('vehicleReturnCheckIds', JSON.stringify(v.returnChecklist.checks.map((c) => c.id))); }

request.description: Takes you offline. Refused while you carry an order (`409 DELIVERIES_IN_PROGRESS`).
Back online for jobs.
Take a fresh selfie first (Presign selfie → Upload) if the punch-in one is older than 10 minutes.
`newDamage: true` needs an `issueNote` of 10+ characters. The odometer can't go backwards.

item.description: Punch-in / punch-out switch this for you. While online, send a GPS ping every `gpsEverySeconds`; without pings you stop getting jobs.

item.description: One offer at a time, for `offerSeconds` (30 s). Offers also arrive on the socket as `rider.offer`.

item.name: 5. The delivery (Quick Commerce & Food)
item.description:
`task.next` lists the steps allowed now. At the shop the rider shows `handover.code` / `handover.qr`; the **shop** marks it picked up.

Food (`vertical: "EAT"`) adds the packaging check, the prep-delay report and cash/UPI collection.

Pick **one** of the *Delivered* requests.

if (t && t.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('taskId', t.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('taskLines', JSON.stringify((t.items || []).filter((i) => !i.outOfStock).map((i) => i.lineId))); }

request.description: Must be within 500 m of the shop (`409 NOT_AT_PICKUP`). Not ready yet → `WAITING_AT_PICKUP`.
Every line that is not out of stock: OK · MISSING · WRONG · DAMAGED (+ note). Built from the last *Open delivery*. Problems show on the shop screen.
Only after ARRIVED_AT_PICKUP while `prep.state = DELAYED` (else `409 PREP_NOT_LATE`, which says when you can).
